commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
uname -a
getent passwd datauser || true
ls -ld /srv /srv/data 2>&1 || true
findmnt -T /srv/data -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS
command -v setquota || true
command -v xfs_quota || true
dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package} ${Status}\n' quota 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'fstab:\n'
sed -n '1,160p' /etc/fstab
printf 'rootdev=%s\n' "$(findmnt -T /srv/data -no SOURCE)"
sudo -n true && printf 'sudo=ok\n' || printf 'sudo=unavailable\n'
id; findmnt -T /srv/data; getent passwd datauser; ls -ld /srv/data
